_about: Stat weights per class.spec for WoW Forever. 'leveling' below level 60, 'endgame' at 60. Equivalence points (AP for physical specs, spell power for casters/healers, Stamina for tanks). Weapon: dps per weapon DPS, offhand_dps, ranged_dps, slow_bonus per second above 2.5. Provisional: no per-level-range stat priorities exist for Forever yet (guides say level 60 data is needed). Values are equivalence points reasoned from the class changes cited above. Whether warcraftdb/Blizzard 'hit'/'crit' numbers are ratings or percent points is unconfirmed.
